premises.text: Language barriers create significant challenges in communication.
premises.evidence_span: we had a big problem with language barriers, working, talking day to day, going to the doctor.

premises.text: Crowdsourcing human interpreters can provide real-time language translation.
premises.evidence_span: it's crowdsourcing of human, real-time human interpreters all around the globe.

premises.text: The platform can connect users with interpreters based on specific language needs.
premises.evidence_span: we really want to have that real-time interpreter in your pocket and you connect and you get somebody in your dialect, in your accent, in your language.

premises.text: The service can provide specialized interpreters for specific fields like medicine.
premises.evidence_span: if you're in a pharmacy, you want to talk, you have a language barrier with somebody, you can get Bubbleworks out and we'll connect you with somebody that can interpret the medical terminology.

premises.text: The platform combines professional interpreters with a crowdsourced model.
premises.evidence_span: it's a hybrid crowdsource kind of solution. So we have professionals.

premises.text: The goal is to cover nearly all spoken languages globally.
premises.evidence_span: there are nearly 7,000 active spoken languages in the world, and we want to cover every single one of those.

premises.text: The platform aims to revolutionize communication by enabling people to speak their native languages.
premises.evidence_span: we think that Babelverse can bring a revolution in communications so that you can travel anywhere in the world and be able to speak with anybody regardless of what language they speak.

value.text: Real-time interpretation can enhance communication across language barriers.
value.evidence_span: everybody can speak their native language and understand each other without having to revert to a de facto language like English.

notes: No separate premises for interpreter profiles and expertise collection as they support the same premise.
